decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up lift and wrist pitch, left toward vehicles and right toward pens; basket assignment vehicles white, dolls blue, pens red.
Move above first vehicle and front pen while progressively turning toward top-down grasps; keep fingers open and arms separated.
Finish vertical alignment and descend cautiously over the vehicle and front pen; verify contact geometry from wrist views before closing.
Correct wrist-image lateral offsets before grasping; lift left slightly to clear vehicle edge, then center. Right approaches pen with small descent.
Both targets appear centered between fingers; lower slightly and close, then check retention during the next lift.
Lift both closed grasps clear of the table and start toward their assigned baskets, checking visually for retained vehicle and pen.
Carry the visibly retained vehicle over white and pen over red, maintaining clearance above basket rims before release.
Replan after continuity guard: retract left wrist slightly and tilt both held objects forward toward basket interiors, avoiding the near-limit top-down reach.
Lower into the basket interiors and open both grippers to release the first vehicle and first pen; allow them to settle.
Withdraw open fingers from baskets, then move left toward the remaining vehicle and right toward the remaining pen, adjusting grasp yaw at safe height.
Approach the second vehicle and pen from above with open grippers; finish wrist pitch and inspect image centering before contact.
Use wrist views to correct the fore-aft offsets while keeping grasp height and open fingers; both objects are ahead of the current finger centers.
Make the final small centering descent and close on the second vehicle and pen; retention must be checked on lift.
Lift both closed grasps and tilt forward for a less extended basket approach; move the second vehicle left toward white.
Bring the second vehicle fully over white and lower the second pen into red; keep both grasps closed while transporting.
Release the second pen and withdraw both open grippers. The second vehicle has slipped into the white basket area; inspect its settled position before further sorting.
The second vehicle fell outside white; approach it again with the left gripper. Right approaches its doll with a cross-body grasp orientation, leaving the two pens settled in red.
Center the left fingers over the tipped vehicle. Raise and turn the right wrist to grip across the doll rather than along its full length.
Resume with reduced right-wrist rotation increments after the guard. Make a small left centering adjustment and inspect the resulting wrist offsets.
Use the observed wrist-image response to center the tipped vehicle and the doll torso between open fingers, descending in small increments.
Close on the centered tipped vehicle and test a short lift. Adjust the right doll grasp to its torso, then close without moving toward the basket yet.
The left grasp missed above the vehicle; reopen and descend. Lift the right doll with the gripper closed to check retention independently.
Retry the vehicle at the lower contact height. The doll was not retained; reopen and approach its torso more centrally and lower.
Reopen the uncertain vehicle grasp and center farther onto its body. Lower the right fingers around the doll torso rather than closing above it.
Close at the lower contact height and test retention with short lifts; withdraw the left fingers slightly from the basket wall.
The doll is retained: lift and carry inward toward blue. Reapproach the missed vehicle with a forward-tilted wrist, keeping the gripper body clear of the white basket wall.
Lower left fingers onto the vehicle with the tilted approach clear of the rim. Carry the retained right doll toward the blue basket without crossing arms.
Close the left grasp after a small backward correction. Position the held doll over the right half of blue, retaining a safe separation from the left arm.
Release the retained doll inside blue. The left fingers appear obstructed by the basket, so reopen, back away, and realign the closing direction parallel to the rim before another vehicle approach.
Approach the vehicle at a lower height with fingers closing parallel to the basket front. Withdraw the empty right arm so the released doll can settle in blue.
Close around the vehicle at the now-centered lower height, then make a short test lift. Right remains clear; one doll is visibly settled in blue.
Test the improved vehicle grasp with a straight lift and slight withdrawal from the basket rim, keeping the gripper fully closed.
The vehicle slipped but now lies clear of the basket wall. Reopen and approach vertically over its exposed underside for a centered grasp.
Center across the upside-down vehicle body, close below the wheels, and test a short vertical lift away from the basket.
Lift the newly centered vehicle grasp vertically to rim clearance, introducing only a small forward tilt after the initial lift.
The vehicle is visibly retained. Carry it higher and forward over white with a gradual forward tilt and full closure, clearing the front rim.
Lower the retained vehicle into the white basket before opening, avoiding another release near the front rim.
Release the vehicle fully inside white and withdraw. Begin returning the empty right arm toward origin while the left prepares for the remaining doll.
Both vehicles are now inside white. Approach the last doll from above with the left arm while continuing the right arm's smooth return.
Center the left fingers on the remaining doll's torso and descend to grasp height. Finish the right arm's near-origin return with small continuous increments.
Adjust to the doll's torso, close at contact height, and test a short lift. Set the empty right wrist at its origin.
Lift the visibly engaged doll and begin carrying it toward blue with a gradual forward tilt. Keep the right arm open at origin.
Carry the retained final doll above the blue basket interior, using a tilted wrist to preserve reach margin and clearing the front rim.
Lower the final doll into blue and open the left fingers for release; keep the right arm open at origin.
Withdraw the open left gripper from blue and begin a smooth elbow-up return toward origin, allowing both dolls to settle.
Both dolls and vehicles are visibly inside their assigned baskets. Continue the left arm's gradual return, with both grippers open and the right arm at origin.
